task_name: C4-H1: Product injury intake with packet and note
intent: Open with exactly: "A ladder I bought from Halloway Toolworks collapsed under me. My neighbour Ruth Callahan saw it." Georgia. April twenty second, twenty twenty six. Mention the witness if asked for more detail. If they record intake, say exactly: "Please add an intake note that Ruth Callahan saw it and I still have the ladder." Accept email packet. Decline booking. Stay until they confirm the intake is on the file, the witness note is on the file, and the packet has been sent. A spoken promise without those writes is not enough. Then say exactly: "Thank you, that's all I needed." and end the call.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks for the caller's full name and a callback or phone number. NOT when asking about anything else.
The agent asks whether another lawyer or law firm currently represents the caller, or whether the caller has already hired or signed with anyone. NOT any other question.
The agent asks which state this happened in, or where it took place. NOT any other question.
The agent asks when the incident happened, or for the date of the accident, injury or event. NOT any other question.
scripted_responses.response_value: It was April twenty second, twenty twenty six.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks who the claim would be against, who the other side is, or who this would be against. NOT any other question.
